messages:
alex: Quick check-in 18:00 PT plan for v2026.2 internal announce. Draft RN in the doc, would love quick reads for rollback language and canary timing.

sam: doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rn/v2026.2 (WIP). Added TL;DR, rollout timeline, and brief troubleshooting tips.

priya: Found a staging perf blip with the new embeddings quant flag on long contexts. Left a note in Known Issues and proposed a short mitigation.

alex: @priya can you add explicit rollback trigger wording? e.g. "If canary p99 embed latency > baseline by 15% for 5m -> rollback to v2026.1 (pin)"

priya: Added: "Rollback to v2026.1 pin if canary SSE p99 latency exceeds baseline by 15% sustained for 5 minutes." Happy to shorten.

maria: Are we pinning the hosted model artifact or using runtime fallback? Need to specify which sha and who to call for ops.

alex: We'll pin hosted to model-green-2026-quant sha:abc123. Add @maria and @jamie as rollback contacts.

jamie: I'll be on-call during the canary window. Dropped a runbook snippet in the doc with the exact rollback command and smoke checks (smoke: 10 reqs/sec, kv cache hit, embed throughput).

alex: Proposed canary window: 02:05-02:35 UTC (low traffic). Canary at 5% traffic, then 30m quiet window after successful canary before ramp. Can we have deploy-bot schedule it?

sam: Done, updated the RN timeline and deploy-bot cue.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job created: canary/v2026.2 @ 2026-05-12T02:05:00Z -> targets: 5% traffic, region: us-west-2. Health checks: p99 latency, error-rate, embed-throughput. Will notify channel on completion.

priya: Suggested metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 latencies, errors, embed token throughput, and KV cache hit rate. I'll paste a short eval script into the doc to compute deltas vs baseline.

sam: RN also has a short comms blurb for PMs and Support: what changed, expected impact, contact for regressions. Kept public-facing microcopy minimal per legal.

maria: Confirmed legal asked to keep public notes minimal; internal RN can contain deeper technical details.

alex: Final preflight checklist: 1) RN link (sam) 2) Runbook + rollback cmd (jamie) 3) Canary scheduled (deploy-bot) 4) Ops standby (jamie, priya) 5) Pin sha in RN (maria). If green I'll post internal announce at 18:00 PT.

jamie: All items 705 from ops.

priya: 705 I'll watch the canary dashboard and post a 10 minute summary.

sam: 705 doc ready for a quick copyedit.

alex: Will post the internal announce at 18:00 PT unless objections. :thumbsup: 

maria: :thumbsup: proceed.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-12T17:50:00Z -> channel eng-releases (internal announce preflight).

alex: Thanks team. I'll post and pin the RN in #eng-releases when live.
